text:
Introduction
This document lists the equipment Inspection
checklist I1, which must be performed monthly as indicated by M1 in the title block.
Safety Precaution
Safety fence with caution marks surrounded the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet & safety belt when cleaning
 suspension insulators.
Isolate
 the auxiliary transformer,
Taking
 out the breaker toward 11KV out of busbar 11KV.
Disconnect
 supply of D.C.
Tools and Equipment
Safety
 helmet, safety belt, and tool set
Voltage
 indicator, Portable
 earth for discharging,
Fine
 cloth for cleaning purposes, Silicagel,
Complete
 tool kit/set, including a torque wrench.
Environmental Recommendation
Before starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer
 wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning. Collect it and send it to the dump.
Fix
 any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.
Oil
leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil and
ground water and eventually on the ecosystem.
"It takes only I liter of Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to
render 1,000,000 liters of potable water useless for human consumption".
Work to be carried out
Clean all porcelain surfaces.
Inspect all painted surface, remove any signs of
 rust and repaint bare spots.
Check for signs of oil leaks.
Check
 oil level in tank and conservator .
Check the condition of the silicagel, replace
 silicagel if its color changed from blue to
 pink.
Check the condition of earthing.
All bolted connections must be checked for
 tightness.
Clean the body, cables and the room of auxiliary
 transformer.
